title: Reading Drill — The Clock in the Station Hall
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Clock in the Station Hall
passages.body:
**A** A transport museum accepted a station clock that had stopped working. Photographs showed it had originally been painted green, but the restorer first examined the mechanism rather than repainting the casing.

**B** The clock was missing a piece that could be reproduced from an inventory drawing. The drawing showed no scale, so the restorer used the matching screws on the surviving frame to infer the missing dimensions.

**C** The museum left one section unpainted to show where later repairs had taken place. A small diagram beside the clock gave dates for the visible alterations when records were available.
